nodes.name: Asteroids.tsx
nodes.summary: React Three Fiber component that renders instanced asteroid meshes with per-instance rotation, collision detection against the player camera and enemy ships, and shader-based explosion visuals on detonation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses InstancedMesh for performance-efficient rendering of 15-25 asteroid objects; collision detection runs inside useFrame per tick.

nodes.name: AsteroidExplosion
nodes.summary: Local React component that renders a timed shader-based explosion sphere for a destroyed asteroid, fading out over 1.4 seconds.

nodes.name: Asteroids
nodes.summary: Exported React Three Fiber component managing asteroid field initialization, instanced mesh rendering, per-frame rotation and collision logic, and explosion effect tracking.

nodes.name: FlightScene.tsx
nodes.summary: Top-level React Three Fiber scene component composing all flight gameplay elements — player ship, enemies, lasers, mines, asteroids, sun, starfield — with debug light helpers and leva-controlled ambient/hemisphere lighting.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses leva controls for runtime light tweaking; debug helpers conditionally rendered based on useDebugStore.

nodes.name: FlightScene
nodes.summary: Exported root scene component that assembles all combat gameplay sub-components under a Three.js group with configurable lighting.

nodes.name: Lasers.tsx
nodes.summary: React Three Fiber component rendering player and enemy laser bolts as instanced cylinder meshes with custom glow shader materials, updated each frame from combat store state.

nodes.name: Lasers
nodes.summary: Exported component managing two instanced meshes for player and enemy lasers, orienting each bolt along its velocity vector and animating shader uniforms per frame.

nodes.name: Mines.tsx
nodes.summary: React Three Fiber component rendering space mines from a GLB model with spinning animation, proximity-based collision detection against the player and enemies, and explosion visuals on detonation.

nodes.name: Mine
nodes.summary: Local component rendering a single rotating mine GLB model with per-frame collision checks against the player camera and enemy ship positions.

nodes.name: Mines
nodes.summary: Exported component that initializes the mine field in the combat store, tracks detonated mines, and renders active Mine instances alongside explosion effects.

nodes.name: Sun.tsx
nodes.summary: React Three Fiber component rendering a slowly rotating distant sun GLB with leva-tunable position, scale, and directional light intensity, converting materials to MeshBasicMaterial for a constant-brightness appearance.

nodes.name: Sun
nodes.summary: Exported component cloning and patching the sun GLB scene to use DoubleSide MeshBasicMaterial, with runtime leva controls for all positional and lighting parameters.

nodes.name: shaders.ts
nodes.summary: GLSL shader source strings and Three.js ShaderMaterial factory functions for the engine glow plasma effect, laser bolt glow, and procedural explosion/fire visuals used throughout the flight scene.
nodes.languageNotes: Inline GLSL uses fractional Brownian motion (fbm) with 4-5 octave value noise for organic plasma and fire effects; laser uses additive blending with instancing support via #ifdef USE_INSTANCING.

nodes.name: makeEngineGlowMaterial
nodes.summary: Factory returning a transparent, additive-blended ShaderMaterial for the engine plasma glow effect with configurable core and flame colors.

nodes.name: makeLaserMaterial
nodes.summary: Factory returning a transparent, additive-blended ShaderMaterial for laser bolt rendering with instancing support and configurable bolt color.

nodes.name: makeExplosionMaterial
nodes.summary: Factory returning a transparent DoubleSide ShaderMaterial for procedural explosion and fire sphere effects with animated vertex displacement and heat-gradient coloring.

nodes.name: LCDPanel.tsx
nodes.summary: Reusable LCD-style panel wrapper component that applies a consistent retro-terminal visual container to any children passed into it.

nodes.name: LCDPanel
nodes.summary: Functional React component rendering a styled LCD panel div that accepts children, optional className, and inline style overrides.

nodes.name: ScanlineOverlay.tsx
nodes.summary: Minimal CRT scanline effect overlay component that renders a full-screen decorative div to simulate a retro CRT monitor aesthetic.

nodes.name: ScanlineOverlay
nodes.summary: Renders a transparent full-screen overlay div styled with CSS scanline stripes for CRT visual effect.

nodes.name: TerminalText.tsx
nodes.summary: Animated terminal-style text component that types out a string character-by-character at a configurable delay, simulating retro terminal output.

nodes.name: TerminalText
nodes.summary: Uses useState and useEffect with setInterval to progressively reveal a text string one character at a time, rendering into a configurable HTML element.

nodes.name: DebugPanel.tsx
nodes.summary: Developer debug panel providing an in-game Leva controls GUI for remapping key bindings and toggling debug visualization overlays such as direction helpers, camera info, stats, and light helpers.

nodes.name: ControlsConfig
nodes.summary: Internal React component that renders Leva GUI controls for each configurable key binding, calling setBinding on user interaction.

nodes.name: DebugControls
nodes.summary: Internal React component using Leva controls to expose boolean toggles for debug visualizations stored in useDebugStore.

nodes.name: DebugPanel
nodes.summary: Exported panel component that mounts the Leva debug GUI on a keyboard shortcut (backtick key) and renders ControlsConfig and DebugControls sub-components.

nodes.name: useControlsConfig.ts
nodes.summary: Custom React hook and default bindings configuration for player input key mappings, providing a Zustand-backed store for reading and updating control bindings.

nodes.name: main.tsx
nodes.summary: Vite/React application bootstrap that mounts the root App component into the DOM using ReactDOM.createRoot.

nodes.name: audio.ts
nodes.summary: Web Audio API utility providing lazy AudioContext initialization and synthesized sound effects for laser fire and explosions using oscillator frequency sweeps.

nodes.name: initAudio
nodes.summary: Lazily creates and resumes the shared AudioContext, supporting both standard and webkit-prefixed constructors for browser compatibility.

nodes.name: playLaserSound
nodes.summary: Synthesizes a short 'pew' laser sound using a square wave oscillator with an exponential frequency drop from 880 Hz to 110 Hz over 100ms.

nodes.name: playExplosionSound
nodes.summary: Synthesizes a low-frequency rumble explosion sound using a sawtooth oscillator sweeping from 150 Hz to 10 Hz over 800ms.

nodes.name: player-ship.glb
nodes.summary: Binary GLTF 3D model asset for the player ship, loaded via useGLTF in launch and landing transition scenes.

nodes.name: GameCanvas.tsx
nodes.summary: Root React Three Fiber Canvas component that hosts a SceneManager routing to game mode scenes and a DebugOverlays layer for stats and gizmos.

nodes.name: SceneManager
nodes.summary: Internal React component that reads currentMode from useGameStore and renders the matching scene component via a switch statement.

nodes.name: DebugOverlays
nodes.summary: Internal React component that conditionally renders drei Stats and GizmoViewport overlays based on useDebugStore flags.

nodes.name: GameCanvas
nodes.summary: Exported root component that creates the R3F Canvas with device pixel ratio and camera defaults, mounting SceneManager and DebugOverlays.

nodes.name: useDebugStore.ts
nodes.summary: Zustand store managing boolean debug overlay flags (stats, directions, camera info, light helpers) with individual setter actions.

nodes.name: BarScene.tsx
nodes.summary: React Three Fiber scene composing a space-bar environment with animated table, Leva-controlled lighting, and optional debug light helpers.

nodes.name: BarScene
nodes.summary: Exported R3F scene component rendering the bar environment with Leva-driven ambient and point light controls, animated floating table, and conditional debug geometry.

nodes.name: BriefingScene.tsx
nodes.summary: React Three Fiber scene for the mission briefing room with a rotating holographic globe and moody blue-tone lighting.

nodes.name: BriefingScene
nodes.summary: Exported R3F scene component rendering a briefing table with a spinning wireframe hologram map and cyan point light.

nodes.name: LandingScene.tsx
nodes.summary: Transition scene animating the player ship decelerating through a lit landing tube, then triggering mission completion and BAR mode on arrival.

nodes.name: LandingScene
nodes.summary: Exported R3F scene that animates the ship along a landing tube, follows with camera shake, calls completeMission and transitions to BAR when z reaches zero.

nodes.name: LaunchScene.tsx
nodes.summary: Transition scene accelerating the player ship through a glowing launch tube, triggering FLIGHT mode once the ship clears the tube.

nodes.name: LaunchScene
nodes.summary: Exported R3F scene that accelerates the cloned player ship model down a torus-ringed tube with camera shake, then sets game mode to FLIGHT.

nodes.name: QuartersScene.tsx
nodes.summary: Static React Three Fiber scene representing the player's personal quarters with a bed, wall, and picture frame composed of basic geometry.

nodes.name: QuartersScene
nodes.summary: Exported R3F scene component rendering a minimal sleeping quarters room using box, plane, and ambient/directional lights.

nodes.name: useGameStore.ts
nodes.summary: Zustand store defining global game state including player credits, current game mode, and actions for mode transitions and credit management consumed across all UI features.
nodes.languageNotes: Zustand store created with the create() pattern; exports a single useGameStore hook that subscribers call to select slices of state.

nodes.name: useMissionStore.ts
nodes.summary: Zustand store managing active mission state including the current mission definition, objective completion tracking, and actions to start missions and update individual objective status.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Minimal Vite HTML shell that sets the page title to 'Valkyrie Wing', mounts the React root div, and loads the TypeScript entry point as an ES module.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: NPM package manifest declaring the valkyrie-wing project with Vite build scripts and core runtime dependencies: React 18, Three.js, @react-three/fiber, @react-three/drei, Zustand, and Leva.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Root TypeScript compiler configuration targeting ES2020 with strict mode, bundler module resolution, React JSX transform, and a project reference to tsconfig.node.json for Vite compilation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses 'bundler' moduleResolution (TS 5.x feature) enabling allowImportingTsExtensions and isolatedModules for Vite compatibility.

nodes.name: tsconfig.node.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript project reference configuration for the Vite build tooling layer, enabling composite mode and applying strict settings to vite.config.ts.

nodes.name: .gitattributes
nodes.summary: Configures Git LFS tracking for `.glb` binary 3D model files, ensuring they are stored via Large File Storage rather than directly in the repository.

nodes.name: .understandignore
nodes.summary: Template ignore file for the understand-anything analysis tool, listing commented-out glob patterns that can be uncommented to exclude files or directories from codebase scanning.

nodes.name: flight.css
nodes.summary: Styles for in-flight HUD elements and UI overlays, including enemy and waypoint label variants, boundary-warning banners with pulse and flash keyframe animations, and a debug camera info panel.

nodes.name: Starfield.tsx
nodes.summary: React Three Fiber component that procedurally generates 5000 stars distributed across a large sphere using spherical coordinates, with per-star color variation (white, blue, and orange) and randomized brightness, memoized for performance.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `useMemo` with an empty dependency array to generate the star geometry once on mount, avoiding per-frame recomputation of 5000 THREE.Color allocations.

nodes.name: Starfield
nodes.summary: Exported React Three Fiber component that builds a points-based star field geometry, distributing stars uniformly on a sphere via spherical-to-Cartesian conversion and rendering them as colored point sprites.

nodes.name: index.css
nodes.summary: Global stylesheet establishing the game's dark sci-fi visual theme: CSS custom properties for neon colors and backgrounds, body/root full-viewport layout, CRT scanline and vignette overlay effects, `.lcd-panel` card component, terminal typography, and an `.interactive-btn` with animated hover sweep.

nodes.name: vite-env.d.ts
nodes.summary: TypeScript ambient declaration file that references Vite client types and declares a module augmentation for `*.glb` files, allowing 3D model assets to be imported as URL strings without type errors.

nodes.name: vite.config.ts
nodes.summary: Vite build configuration that registers the React plugin for JSX/TSX transformation and adds `**/*.glb` to `assetsInclude` so Three.js GLB model files are handled as static assets with URL imports.

nodes.name: Enemies.tsx
nodes.summary: React Three Fiber component rendering active enemy ships with engine glow shaders, health HUD labels, target bracket overlay, explosion visuals, and arcade wave progression via useMissionStore integration.
nodes.languageNotes: Updated to import useMissionStore and adds useEffect for arcade wave completion with clearTimeout cleanup to prevent stale timers.

nodes.name: TargetBracket
nodes.summary: Local component rendering world-space corner bracket geometry around the currently locked target enemy, scaling with camera distance and facing the camera billboard-style.

nodes.name: Enemies
nodes.summary: Exported component that drives enemy AI updates each frame via updateEnemies, detects arcade wave completion, and renders active EnemyShip instances and explosion effects.

nodes.name: EnemyShip
nodes.summary: Local component rendering a single enemy ship using a cloned GLB scene, engine glow shader, and health label, orienting the model toward its velocity vector each frame.

nodes.name: enemyAI.ts
nodes.summary: Pure-function enemy AI module exporting the EnemyData type, EnemyBehavior FSM state type, selectBehavior for probabilistic state transitions, and computeSteering for per-behavior velocity computation including formation flying and separation forces.
nodes.languageNotes: New file extracted from useCombatStore — pure functions with no side effects or React dependencies, enabling easier testing and reuse.

nodes.name: selectBehavior
nodes.summary: Pure function implementing the enemy FSM state transition: ticks the behavior timer down and rolls a distance/random weighted transition to approach, strafe, flank, evade, or formation.

nodes.name: computeSteering
nodes.summary: Pure function computing a steering velocity vector for an enemy given its current behavior state, handling approach/strafe/flank/evade/formation modes with predictive intercept targeting, oscillation noise, and separation from other enemies.

nodes.name: useCombatStore.ts
nodes.summary: Central Zustand combat state store managing lasers, enemy ships, mines, and asteroids with full simulation logic: laser movement and collision, enemy AI updates delegating to enemyAI.ts, ship-to-ship collision damage, and arcade wave spawning.
nodes.languageNotes: Updated to import selectBehavior and computeSteering from enemyAI.ts; startArcadeWave now clears _enemyCollisionCooldowns Map to prevent stale cooldown state across waves.

nodes.name: updateEnemies
nodes.summary: Per-frame enemy update: invokes selectBehavior and computeSteering from enemyAI.ts, applies velocity lerp, handles probabilistic enemy laser firing with predictive aim, and applies ship-to-ship collision damage with cooldown tracking.

nodes.name: updateLasers
nodes.summary: Per-frame player laser update: advances positions, culls by lifetime, detects collisions with enemies/mines/asteroids, applies damage, updates mission objectives, and triggers audio on kills.

nodes.name: updateEnemyLasers
nodes.summary: Per-frame enemy laser update: advances positions, detects player collision with directional hit-side determination, and applies damage via dynamic import of useGameStore.

nodes.name: startArcadeWave
nodes.summary: Spawns a scaled enemy wave for the current arcade level: clears collision cooldowns, computes enemy count as 3 + (level-1)*2, and initializes enemies with flocked formation assignments.

nodes.name: App.tsx
nodes.summary: Root React application component that orchestrates game mode switching between bar and flight scenes, wires up audio initialization, and renders the shared UI shell (GameCanvas, HUD, LCD overlays, ErrorBoundary).

nodes.name: App
nodes.summary: Top-level React component that reads game and mission state, initializes audio on first launch, and conditionally renders BarUI or FlightHUD based on the current game mode.

nodes.name: ErrorBoundary.tsx
nodes.summary: React class component that catches unhandled errors from R3F/Three.js subtrees and displays a styled 'SYSTEM FAILURE' fallback screen, preventing full-page crashes during 3D rendering.

nodes.name: ErrorBoundary
nodes.summary: React error boundary class that captures render errors via getDerivedStateFromError and renders a styled fallback UI matching the game's terminal aesthetic.

nodes.name: BarUI.tsx
nodes.summary: Thin routing shell for the bar scene that maintains a currentView state and delegates rendering to one of four self-contained sub-view components (MainView, ArcadeView, BartenderView, CommandosView).

nodes.name: BarUI
nodes.summary: React component that switches between bar sub-views via a currentView state string, passing onBack and onNavigate callbacks to child views.

nodes.name: ArcadeView.tsx
nodes.summary: Bar arcade cabinet sub-view that displays a leaderboard loaded from localStorage, allows the player to spend credits to launch an arcade wave mission, and handles error states.

nodes.name: ArcadeView
nodes.summary: Reads game/mission/combat stores, loads a localStorage leaderboard, and provides a play button that deducts credits, starts an arcade wave, and transitions game mode to flight.

nodes.name: BartenderView.tsx
nodes.summary: Bar NPC interaction sub-view for the bartender character, presenting drink purchase options that cost credits and drive scrolling dialogue exchanges.

nodes.name: BartenderView
nodes.summary: Renders a dialogue panel with drink order buttons; handleOrder deducts credits and pushes flavour dialogue lines into a local state array.

nodes.name: CommandosView.tsx
nodes.summary: Multi-character commando NPC sub-view that implements a branching conversation tree with three selectable characters, credit-gated dialogue, and dynamic option building.

nodes.name: CommandosView
nodes.summary: Orchestrates branching NPC dialogue via activeCharacter, dialogue, and conversationOptions state; buildOptions and handleChoice implement the conversation flow with credit costs.

nodes.name: MainView.tsx
nodes.summary: Bar landing view that presents the player's credit balance and navigation buttons to reach the arcade, bartender, or commandos sub-views, plus direct mode-change shortcuts.

nodes.name: MainView
nodes.summary: Displays player credits and renders navigation buttons; calls onNavigate prop to route to sub-views and setMode to switch game mode.

nodes.name: FlightHUD.tsx
nodes.summary: Flight mode heads-up display component that owns all in-flight overlays: mission objectives, enemy count, boundary warnings, arcade score tracking, and mission-complete/game-over screens.

nodes.name: FlightHUD
nodes.summary: Reads gameStore, missionStore, and combatStore to compute HUD state; saveLeaderboardAndExit persists arcade scores to localStorage and transitions back to bar mode on completion or death.

nodes.name: CockpitHUD.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the in-flight HUD overlay including a Canvas-based radar with enemy blips and waypoint markers, throttle bar, health/shield/energy stat bars, speed readout, and a target info panel; reads controls imperatively via a MutableRefObject to avoid React re-renders on keypress.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses imperative DOM mutations inside useFrame for the throttle bar fill, bypassing React state to eliminate per-keypress re-renders; the radar is drawn entirely on a canvas element via 2D context each frame.

nodes.name: CockpitHUD
nodes.summary: Main HUD React component that subscribes to combat, game, and mission stores and imperatively paints a radar canvas each frame via useFrame; exported as the primary consumer-facing component.

nodes.name: StatBar
nodes.summary: Small helper component that renders a labeled percentage bar for health, shield, or energy values, clamping value to [0, 100].

nodes.name: PlayerShip.tsx
nodes.summary: Core Three.js R3F scene object that loads the player ship GLTF model, drives flight physics each frame by reading controls imperatively, handles laser firing toward the lead pip, manages camera positioning for cockpit and 3rd-person modes, and checks waypoint proximity for mission objectives.
nodes.languageNotes: Caches controls.current as a local const at the top of each useFrame callback to avoid repeated MutableRef dereferences; combines Three.js useFrame physics with React state only for coarse perspective toggles.

nodes.name: PlayerShip
nodes.summary: Top-level R3F component that orchestrates ship movement, camera follow, laser firing, target locking and cycling, collision damage, boundary enforcement, and mission waypoint checking within a single useFrame loop.

nodes.name: LeadIndicator
nodes.summary: Renders a 3D lead-pip reticle mesh that tracks the predicted intercept position of the locked target each frame, accounting for target velocity and projectile time-of-flight.

nodes.name: TargetingReticle
nodes.summary: Renders a procedural corner-bracket targeting reticle geometry around the locked enemy using a custom BufferGeometry built from line segments.

nodes.name: DirectionArrows
nodes.summary: Displays an ArrowHelper indicating the ship's current velocity direction in local space, updated each frame to aid spatial orientation during development.

nodes.name: usePlayerControls.ts
nodes.summary: Custom React hook that maps keyboard events to a stable MutableRefObject<Controls> using a user-configurable key-binding table, eliminating React re-renders on every keypress by writing directly into a ref instead of calling setState.
nodes.languageNotes: The ref-based pattern is the key performance optimisation: consumers read controls.current inside useFrame without triggering React reconciliation on keydown/keyup events.

nodes.name: usePlayerControls
nodes.summary: React hook that attaches keydown/keyup window listeners, translates key codes to control actions via the bound key config, and returns a stable ref whose .current value is mutated in place.

nodes.name: codeToAction
nodes.summary: Maps a KeyboardEvent.code string to a Controls action name by checking it against each binding slot in the user's key config.
